title: Normalization and naturality equations for the specified tensor representatives
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism, R,S commutative ring sheaves on the small pro-etale sites and c:f^{-1}R≅S [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let a,b be the given tensor models [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model] and alpha the selected canonical tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. For flat K-flat P,Q, there are proofs that CP,CQ remain flat K-flat such that DC(r_a(P,Q));alpha(QP,QQ);b.tensor(e_C(P),e_C(Q))=e_C(Tot(P,Q));Q(t_C(P,Q).inv);r_b(CP,CQ), where C is termwise geometric module pullback, DC its exact derived functor, e_C the specified factorization, t_C the ordinary signed-total comparison [def-sp-proetale-ordinary-tensor-pullback-total], and Tot the actual uncurried signed-total functor. Also, for any tensor model a and chain maps v:P→P′,w:Q→Q′ between flat K-flat endpoints, r_a(P,Q);a.tensor(Qv,Qw)=Q(Tot(v,w));r_a(P′,Q′). These are equations for the already supplied comparisons, not new choices of them.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0G7E, normalized geometric tensor pullback on flat K-flat representatives and naturality of the tensor representative.

proof.text: The existing canonical tensor comparison is defined by choosing the unique natural isomorphism of proEtaleCanonicalTensorPullback. Its choice specification at P,Q gives the required witnesses and equation. Express its total-complex source using the uncurried total functor and its localized map as Q.map of the inverse. This changes no data.

For naturality, regard v and w as morphisms in the full subcategory of flat K-flat complexes, using the endpoint proofs. Apply naturality of the supplied representative natural isomorphism to their product and reverse the equation. The two functors evaluate as the stated Q(Tot(v,w)) and derived tensor map. This works for zero endpoints as well.

lean.statement:
theorem canonical_tensor_representative {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S)
    (a : ProEtaleTensorModel Y R) (b : ProEtaleTensorModel X S)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Y R) ℤ)
    (hp : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y R P) (hq : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y R Q) :
    ∃ (hp' : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives X S
        (((proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
      (hq' : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives X S
        (((proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)),
      (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback f R S c).map
          (a.representative.hom.app (⟨P, hp⟩, ⟨Q, hq⟩)) ≫
        (proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison f R S c a b).hom.app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫
        b.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom
          ((proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors f R S c).hom.app P)
          ((proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors f R S c).hom.app Q)) =
      (proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors f R S c).hom.app
          ((CoefficientTensorChain.total Y R).obj (P, Q)) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso f R S c P Q).inv ≫
        b.representative.hom.app (⟨_, hp'⟩, ⟨_, hq'⟩)
